# langfuse_projects (Data Source)

List the projects of the organization that an organization-scoped API key belongs to.

## Example Usage

```terraform
variable "organization_public_key" {
  type      = string
  sensitive = true
}

variable "organization_private_key" {
  type      = string
  sensitive = true
}

data "langfuse_projects" "all" {
  organization_public_key  = var.organization_public_key
  organization_private_key = var.organization_private_key
}

output "project_names" {
  value = [for project in data.langfuse_projects.all.projects : project.name]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `organization_private_key` (String, Sensitive) The organization private key used to authenticate API calls.
- `organization_public_key` (String, Sensitive) The organization public key used to authenticate API calls.

### Read-Only

- `projects` (Attributes List) The projects of the organization. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--projects))

<a id="nestedatt--projects"></a>
### Nested Schema for `projects`

Read-Only:

- `id` (String) The project ID.
- `metadata` (String) The project metadata as a JSON object.
- `name` (String) The project name.
